status_summary: On 2025-08-06 Executive Order 14329 imposed an additional 25 percent duty on products of India, and Executive Order 14384 of 2026-02-06 eliminated it, effective 2026-02-07, citing India's commitments to stop importing Russian oil and to a 10-year defense cooperation framework, as the two governments issued a joint statement on a framework for an interim trade agreement. On 2026-05-26 the Quad foreign ministers, including the US Secretary of State, met in New Delhi and agreed a Quad Critical Minerals Framework, an Indo-Pacific energy security initiative, port work with Fiji and maritime domain awareness steps, with no date set for a leaders' summit. No South Asia strategy or Quad-Plus step was found, and the Pakistan element runs the other way: according to a CSIS analysis, the administration hosted Pakistan's prime minister and army chief at the White House and the Export-Import Bank approved about $1.25 billion for the Reko Diq mining project in December 2025. The United States does not recognize the Taliban, and its reported contact has centered on detainee releases (Boston Globe).

timeline.event: Executive Order 14329 imposed an additional 25 percent ad valorem duty on products of India under the Russia-related emergency.

Executive Order 14384 eliminated the additional 25 percent duty on products of India, effective 2026-02-07; the United States and India issued a joint statement the same day on a framework for an interim trade agreement.

The Quad foreign ministers, including the US Secretary of State, met in New Delhi and issued a joint statement launching a Quad Critical Minerals Framework and an Indo-Pacific energy security initiative, committing to port work with Fiji and to maritime domain awareness steps in the Indian Ocean, and looking forward to a leaders' summit without setting a date.

title: Make India the Quad cornerstone, set a South Asia strategy, no normal ties with Taliban
uncertainties: Executive Order 14384, the 2026-02-06 US-India joint statement and the 2026-05-26 Quad foreign ministers' joint statement (as posted by the Australian foreign minister's office) were read on government hosts; none of these documents mentions a South Asia strategy, a Quad-Plus format, Pakistan or Afghanistan, and the US State Department copy could not be reached. The trade documents address tariffs, Russian oil and defense cooperation rather than the Quad, so they bear on the India element only indirectly. The 2025-08-06 date for the India duty is taken from the text of Executive Order 14384; Executive Order 14329 itself was not opened. The Pakistan description rests on a think-tank report that gives no dates for the White House meetings, and the Taliban finding rests on one newspaper report of prisoner talks; no formal recognition was found. The National Security Strategy mentions India and the Quad, mentions Pakistan only as a party to a peace deal with India and does not mention Afghanistan. Judgment: the stage reflects the whole recommendation, with the Quad element partly advancing and the Pakistan element running opposite.
